const data = $('Random Pick (No Duplicates)1').first().json;
const caption = $('Generate Caption (Claude)1').first().json.content[0].text.trim();

const automationSteps = {
  'Lead Engine': ['Identify & enrich target businesses', 'AI scores leads by fit & intent', 'Personalised outreach sent automatically'],
  'WhatsApp Automation': ['Inbound message received 24/7', 'AI classifies intent instantly', 'Replies, books, or routes to human'],
  'Appointment Booking': ['Client requests via any channel', 'System checks availability & books', 'Confirmation + reminders sent auto'],
  'Follow-up Sequences': ['Trigger fires after enquiry or quote', 'Multi-touch sequence runs over days', 'Hot leads flagged for human follow-up'],
  'Invoice & Payment Chase': ['Invoice sent on job completion', 'Auto reminders at 3, 7, 14 days', 'Payment confirmed and logged'],
  'Onboarding Automation': ['Client signs up or pays', 'Welcome sequence fires instantly', 'Documents collected, tasks assigned'],
  'Review & Reputation': ['Service marked complete in CRM', 'Review request sent at right moment', 'Negative feedback flagged privately'],
  'CRM Data Enrichment': ['New contact added to CRM', 'AI pulls public data to enrich record', 'Full profile ready before first call'],
  'Content Automation': ['Topic picked from content matrix', 'AI researches and writes post', 'Infographic generated and published'],
  'CV & Hiring Pipeline': ['CV received via email or form', 'AI scores against job criteria', 'Top candidates notified, rest thanked'],
  'Event & Webinar Engine': ['Registration captured on landing page', 'Reminder sequence fires automatically', 'Post-event follow-up routes hot leads'],
  'Reporting & Dashboards': ['Data pulled from all sources nightly', 'AI summarises key metrics and trends', 'Report delivered to inbox by 8AM'],
  'Internal Ops Automation': ['Request or trigger received', 'Task assigned, approval routed', 'Notification sent, outcome logged'],
  'E-commerce Automation': ['Customer action triggers workflow', 'Personalised message sent instantly', 'Purchase, review, or return handled'],
  'Referral Engine': ['Satisfied client identified in CRM', 'Referral ask sent at peak satisfaction', 'Referral tracked and reward triggered'],
  'Research Automation': ['Keywords and sources configured once', 'AI monitors news and competitors daily', 'Summary delivered to inbox or Slack'],
  'Proposal & Quote Engine': ['Enquiry form or CRM trigger fires', 'AI generates personalised proposal', 'PDF sent to prospect within minutes']
};

const steps = automationSteps[data.automationType] || ['Trigger fires automatically', 'AI processes and acts', 'Outcome logged and notified'];
const filename = 'post_' + Date.now() + '.png';

return [{ json: {
  sector: data.sector,
  niche: data.niche,
  automationType: data.automationType,
  automationDesc: data.automationDesc,
  combo: data.combo,
  remaining: data.remaining,
  totalIndustries: data.totalIndustries,
  totalAutomations: data.totalAutomations,
  totalUsed: data.totalUsed,
  caption: caption,
  steps: steps,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  filename: filename
} }];

Transform the following caption into a structured infographic brief. Be concise, punchy, and specific to the niche.

Return ONLY this exact structure, no extra text:

HEADLINE: [punchy 6-9 word hook]
SUBHEADLINE: [one supporting line, max 10 words]
PROBLEM_1: [pain point, max 5 words]
PROBLEM_2: [pain point, max 5 words]
PROBLEM_3: [pain point, max 5 words]
STEP_1: [automation action, max 6 words]
STEP_2: [automation action, max 6 words]
STEP_3: [automation action, max 6 words]
STAT: [key measurable result or benefit, max 8 words]
CTA: [conversational question, max 10 words]

Caption:
{{ $('Prepare Infographic Data1').item.json.caption }}

The infographic must be specifically about: {{ $('Prepare Infographic Data1').item.json.automationType }} for {{ $('Prepare Infographic Data1').item.json.niche }} businesses. Do not create generic content.
